## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover the change (bugs: a test that failed before the fix)
- [ ] A changeset is included (`pnpm changeset`) if a published package changed
- [ ] Docs updated (package README, `docs/`, or an ADR) if behaviour or API changed
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, [DCO](../CONTRIBUTING.md#sign-your-commits-dco))
